details: bigbob22-test@1.0.0 has no functional code and an empty README. Its preinstall script runs `node preinstall.js` on npm install, which POSTs the machine's hostname, the OS username and the local time to the Discord webhook `https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/pM5rDIrCRrEpQRbA7ibaiQk1XOQlIftmBacA5s8jD8NvXn5W-rS832DOWHQS-G-j3N6U` as "PC Notifier". It was published by the npm account cutekitten05, which used the same script in wallet-adapter-base, axelarjs-sdk, cutekitten-test and sol-wallet-adapter on 2026-11-01.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
